title: Build operational logistics communications
goal: Implement the organization/tour/event operational communications contract for announcements, acknowledgements, mentions, delivery state, and source links.

in: Organization/tour/event scoped operational communications over existing announcement, group-thread, task-message and acknowledgement records
Announcement and task feed, current-user mention projection, pending acknowledgement and non-responder projection
Preserving direct and group messaging in the global inbox without duplicating canonical message records
out: Provider-specific delivery detail until a configured provider contract exists
New message tables or copies of canonical message records
Admin logistics surfaces owned by the admin/work lanes (app/api/admin/**, components/work-mode/**)

working_set: app/api/admin/logistics/communications-command-center/route.ts (read only; app/api/admin/** is the admin lane's)
components/admin/logistics/communications-command-center.tsx (read only; components/admin/** is the admin lane's)
acceptance_criteria: Operational communications are read from canonical records and never create a duplicate message row
Announcement, mention and acknowledgement projections are scoped to an organization/tour/event acting context
Direct and group messaging continue to appear in the global inbox
Provider-specific delivery state is not claimed until a configured provider contract exists

evidence: Operational feed reuses native group threads/messages, event bulletins, task messages, and logistics acknowledgements; it creates no duplicate message records.

Wave 35 (2026-09-26): this lane changed no file in this task's surface. The surface lives under app/api/admin/** and components/admin/**, which are the admin/work lanes' paths and outside social's grant, so the Wave 35 work (the post_likes server read, the interaction-route gate inventory, and the follow contract) does not touch it and could not.

Wave 35 regression context: the combined __tests__/social + __tests__/messaging run (16 files / 128 tests) and the __tests__/polls + __tests__/feed run (15 files / 118 tests) are both green, so the social-owned messaging and engagement contracts that the operational feed composes over are unchanged and passing.
NOT verified: no pilot delivery-state data was available, and no hosted run was performed. Provider-specific delivery detail remains unimplemented because no provider contract is configured.
